cards.name: Superior deep lateral cervical nodes
cards.function: Upper half of the deep cervical chain along the internal jugular vein, from the skull base to the omohyoid crossing; the first deep station for the tonsil, tongue, pharynx and the superficial ring of the head.

details.label: Location
details.value: Along the upper internal jugular vein deep to sternocleidomastoid, from below the posterior belly of digastric and the skull base down to the juguloomohyoid node, with the accessory nerve crossing the top of the group

details.label: Divisions
details.value: Jugulodigastric node (largest, where the posterior belly of digastric crosses the vein); remaining superior deep lateral nodes along the vein down to the juguloomohyoid node

details.label: Drains
details.value: Palatine tonsil, tongue and pharynx (with the retropharyngeal nodes), and efferents of the parotid, mastoid, occipital, facial, submandibular and submental nodes

details.label: Efferents to
details.value: Juguloomohyoid node and inferior deep lateral cervical nodes, then the jugular trunk

details.label: Level
details.value: II and upper III (level terms are surgical, not atlas labels)

cards.pearl: These are the nodes palpated along the anterior border of sternocleidomastoid during a neck examination; a persistent firm upper jugular node in an adult warrants a search for an oropharyngeal, nasopharyngeal or oral primary.

cards.name: Nasolabial nodes (facial nodes)
cards.function: Uppermost subgroup of the facial nodes, beside the nose along the facial vessels; filters lymph from the nose, medial cheek and upper lip on its way to the submandibular nodes.

details.label: Location
details.value: In the nasolabial groove beside the ala of the nose, along the facial vein, above the buccinator nodes

details.label: Drains
details.value: Side of the nose, medial cheek, upper lip, medial eyelids

details.label: Efferents to
details.value: Buccinator and mandibular nodes, then the submandibular nodes (level IB)

details.label: Level
details.value: Not a formal neck level (facial group)

cards.pearl: A nodule in the nasolabial fold near a nasal or cheek skin cancer may be a facial node metastasis, which lies outside a standard neck dissection field.

cards.name: Buccinator nodes (facial nodes)
cards.function: Middle subgroup of the facial nodes, on the buccinator muscle along the facial vein; filters lymph from the cheek before it reaches the submandibular nodes.

details.label: Location
details.value: On the surface of the buccinator near the angle of the mouth, along the facial vein, between the nasolabial and mandibular nodes

details.label: Drains
details.value: Skin and mucosa of the cheek, lateral lips, lower eyelid; efferents of the nasolabial nodes

details.label: Efferents to
details.value: Mandibular nodes and the submandibular nodes (level IB)

details.label: Level
details.value: Not a formal neck level (facial group)

cards.pearl: An enlarged buccinator node presents as a mobile lump in the cheek and can be mistaken for a parotid duct stone, an accessory parotid tumor or a minor salivary gland tumor.

cards.name: Mandibular nodes (facial nodes)
cards.function: Lowest subgroup of the facial nodes, on the outer surface of the mandible where the facial vessels cross its lower border; the last facial station before the submandibular nodes.

details.label: Location
details.value: On the lateral surface of the body of the mandible at the anterior border of masseter, beside the facial artery and vein, above the submandibular nodes

details.label: Drains
details.value: Cheek and lower face; efferents of the nasolabial and buccinator nodes

details.label: Level
details.value: Not a formal neck level (facial group); lies just above level IB

cards.pearl: These nodes lie next to the marginal mandibular branch of the facial nerve, which is at risk when they are removed with the facial vessels during level IB dissection (lower lip weakness).
